prompt: An administrator is tired of granting repository access person by person. What is the recommended pattern?
explanation: Teams are the delivery mechanism for access: group people, grant the team its role, and membership does the rest — new joiners get everything on arrival, leavers lose it on removal. Team-based access over per-person grants is nearly an exam answer verbatim.

options.text: Give the permission to a team once — every member inherits it
Create a shared personal account named `dev-team`
